summary: @lyxa.ai/core bootstrap routes installer event traffic and Firebase operations to author-controlled backends by default
details: The exported bootstrapCore() calls initEventBus() with a hardcoded amqps:// URL and embedded credentials pointing at the author's CloudAMQP broker at dog.lmq.cloudamqp.com/adlvedna, with no override path exposed at that call site. Consumers that use the advertised bootstrap have their subscribed event traffic published to and consumed from an author-owned broker rather than an installer-configured endpoint. ConfigurationService additionally ships default firebaseAdminServiceAccount entries containing four full RSA private keys and client emails for GCP projects for-poc-325210, lyxa-rider-88939, and lyxa-shop; if a consumer bootstraps without overriding firebaseAdmin, all Firebase Admin operations (FCM sends, user/rider/shop admin calls) execute against those author-controlled Firebase projects, meaning notification content and admin state changes are directed at author infrastructure. The same tarball therefore also exposes live GCP service-account private keys and CloudAMQP credentials belonging to the author.
